about_the_game:
Explore the lush themes from the Outskirts and beyond! Immerse yourself into the world of The Knightling wherever you are, accompanied by these wonderfully atmospheric and playful compositions.

The complete soundtrack consists of 31 tracks taken from the game, all lovingly recorded with real musicians in our studios in Berlin, as well as one gorgeous, fully orchestrated bonus track from the official announcement trailer recorded with the Budapest Scoring Orchestra.

The OST, delivered in both 320kbps .mp3 and high quality 48kHz .flac formats, is written and produced by Tumult Kollektiv: Jonathan Howe, Leonhard van Voorst and Alexander van der Kruijf.

We are incredibly grateful to all the musicians that helped this soundtrack come to life and hope the love and care poured into the music resonates with you. Thank you for listening!
